notes:
Summary: most meta moments end at a toast or banner plus one sound. The strongest juice already exists on the machine side (debt terminal deposit, quota-met cutscene, the Pawn's stamp purchase, machine win pops) and is not reused for meta moments. Cheapest wins: (a) bind ui.bigWin (src/core/ui/ui.ts:699, currently only benchRun.ts:236) to the Dawn payoff; (b) give the registered-but-unused HUD anchors (quota, tickets, charms) a bump or fly; (c) consume events nobody handles (quota:overshoot, buff:add, charm evolution, run:rescue 'taken', the spotlight Ticket flag).

Possible bug, verify in play: the terminal LED and BANK read this.shownDep (src/machines/debt_terminal/index.ts:884, :938). shownDep is re-synced only on deposit, withdraw (:756, :795, :821, :844) and on a paid or Night change (:875). Settle interest raises debtPaid (src/game/run.ts:1849) and emits run:deposit, which the terminal does not consume (grep), so the BANK figure may stay at its pre-interest value until the next deposit or withdraw.

Dead or unused code: .hud .wallet.gain (src/menu/hud/hud.css:31) is never applied, a free glow for wallet gains. spotlightTicketLine (src/game/spotlight.ts:79) and houseMoodLine (src/game/houseMood.ts:35) have no callers.

Dawn sequence today: quota_met cutscene (9 s, src/game/story/cutscenes/quota_met.cutscene.ts:4-22) then Dawn receipt count-up (nightCards.ui.ts:116-127) then Night Card offer (silent open, silent pick) then overpay pick (silent open) then NIGHT PAID toast. For quota met, the terminal flash, the cutscene and any HUD burst would all fire on the same beat, so pick one lead layer per stage and make the Dawn a single timeline.

Settings: fx.shake and fx.flash honour settings.shake and reduceFlashing (src/core/fx.ts:117-130), and ui.bigWin reduces coins and flashes under reduceFlashing (src/core/ui/ui.ts:498, :526-527). Route new flashes through app.fx.flash.

Caveats: static reading of the working tree, which has uncommitted changes (git status lists run.ts, hud.ts, nightCards*, checkpoints, tutorial and others), so line numbers reflect that tree. Nothing was run and nothing was edited. "No consumer" and "no call site" claims are grep-based over src; confirm before wiring, especially setUpgradeVisuals (no caller found) and buff:add.

Dopamine levers not used anywhere in meta yet: anticipation (the Night Card timer already pulses but the pick is not built up), count-ups on each ledger line, escalating tiers (copy the celebrate ladder in src/machines/_base/juice.ts:150), and a visible win or loss streak counter.
